0022600225.text: The Houston Rockets, 8-3 overall and 5-1 at home, host the Golden State Warriors, also 8-3, in the 12th game of the Rockets' season. Houston is second in the Southwest, one game back, and fifth in the West, while Golden State is third in the West, second in the Pacific 1.5 games back, and riding an eight-game winning streak after going 8-2 over its last ten. Houston is without Clint Capela (ankle sprain) and Steven Adams (calf strain), and Golden State is missing Brandon Williams (hamstring), Gary Payton II (knee inflammation), Jimmy Butler III (knee surgery), Kristaps Porzingis (illness), and Moses Moody (knee surgery), with Will Richard listed as day-to-day with a thumb injury and a game-time decision. The teams have not met yet in 2026-27, and the Rockets won the 2025-26 season series 2-1, including a 117-116 win in San Francisco on April 5, 2026.
